September 16, 2026

Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20426

Re: COMMENTS P-15424

Docket(s): P-15424
Lead Applicant: DeepGreen SPV LLC

Dear Madam Secretary:

I am writing again to make a correction and clarification to our September 14, 2026,
correspondence to you commenting on P-15424.

In its application for its proposed project in Eastport, Maine, DeepGreen made reference to
ORPC in the following section:

      8. DISCLOSURE OF OVERLAPPING BOUNDARY AND INTEGRATION STRATEGY The Applicant
      acknowledges Preliminary Permit No. P-15285 (ORPC), which occupies a portion of the
      proposed Hub boundary. Pursuant to FERC’s preference for comprehensive resource
      development, the Applicant asserts that this proposal is an Infrastructure-Layer Expansion.
      The "Open Architecture" UDCs are designed to host third-party hardware (including ORPC
      units), providing a scalable platform to move the Western Passage from 5.0 MW to a 51.0
      MW commercial utility.

This statement could be interpreted that extensive discussions have happened between
ORPC and DeepGreen regarding the integration of ORPC’s turbines onto DeepGreen’s
proposed data center. We are submitting this comment to clarify for FERC that ORPC has
no involvement in DeepGreen's project and that no conversations have occurred between
ORPC and DeepGreen regarding the integration of ORPC turbines with DeepGreen’s
proposed data center.

Sincerely,
